baseline: Use existing genericpolicyv4 unchanged baseline first. reference_semantics.citation_only_proposal: A complete supported ref definition whose direct content consists only of whitespace/comments and one or more explicitly schema-validated bibliographic citation templates or labelled literal bibliographic URL constructs. Preserve complete raw bytes, parameters, source spans, names/groups, all definition/reuse occurrences and source-bound marker. All same-page definition/conflict/opaque guards remain.
reference_semantics.explanatory_note: Any non-whitespace authored Text outside bibliographic templates, mixed prose+citations, grouped notes or explanatory/quote parameters is a semantic note. Retain complete containing lead/H2 as dependency-held, with complete raw note companion and marker diagnostic only if visibly inseparable from companion. Do not emit the main prose as independently sufficient.
reference_semantics.field_policy: Exact small versioned bibliographic field schema must be independently reviewed before executable use: author/editor/contributor/title/URL/publication/date/edition/page identifiers as source values; quote/quotation/transcript or unknown fields preserve semantic dependency holds. No claim arbitrary field name proves its text non-substantive; no date/edition correction or URL fetch.
reference_semantics.unresolved: Missing/conflicting name/group definition, invalid attributes, nested unknown/reference or opaque container, unsupported Cite/SFN/efn/refn/template construct or unknown citationfield holds complete dependent unit, preserves raw sidecar. No numbered-marker invention from unresolved names.
reference_semantics.bibliography: Original reference/reflist/notelist/bibliography sections remain preserved whole nonprose/held companions. Citation markers require actual bound definitions; no blind removal of bibliography or conflation of prose footnotes with sources.
reference_semantics.output: A reference is never silently deleted: marker plus complete source-bound companion; standalone-prose eligibility has a separate semantic-independence verdict, unresolved by an AST parse alone.

standalone_components.boundary: Only complete top-level node occupying its own physical source line with whitespace outside node, supported AST name/attributes and exact original source span. Multiline node must serialize exactly; no nested-node escape. No arbitrary firstparagraph/firstNwords deletion.
standalone_components.maintenance: Reuse finite explicit existing language/date-style metadata names and validated date-only fields; standalone exact raw companion, preserve all values. Unknown maintenance names or values hold, no keyword classification.
standalone_components.infobox: Only exact verified schema names, full raw parameter/node companion. Infobox values may supply facts absent from prose, so semantic-companion independence hold remains. An infobox prefix/name does not prove safe loss; no regex generic stripping.
standalone_components.semantic_inline: Any inline convert/lang/reign/date/flag/coord/name or other substantive template holds complete containing prose unit until explicit source-supported semantic mapping exists. No field guessing, fallback to first parameter or blank replacement.
standalone_components.navigation_taxonomy_media: Standalone supported category/file/navigation nodes preserve all labels/captions/options in typed companions with independence holds. Lists are not automatically navigation; subject/procedure/reference lists retained. Unknown namespace remains unknown.
standalone_components.headings: Partition entire lead/H2, include subordinate H3+ nodes. Whole unit cannot be called coherent solely because unknown components were removed; quality/context/rights/language/family/leakage review remains.
